scope: Ordinary 1000-row transactions grow one database through 600k/1M/5M/10M/20M with default cache and automatic maintenance. limitations: A same-binary reference restores previous underflow reads; not a separate historical executable.
Measures full vacuum only; build, update, point read, pagination, LSM and memory are not A/B performance results.
Database grows across scales; not five independent builds from empty.
Shared host and filesystem load; wall-time fluctuations remain. Allocation reduction is not proof of overall speedup.
Linux GNU cross-check only, no Linux runtime verification.
Pending LSM source edits during later measurement were not compiled into this executable; M142 commit excludes them.
